name: Topside decks
description: Read sources describe topside structural concepts (single integrated deck, split deck, integrated deck with living quarters, modular topside on a module support frame), weight bands and one-lift installation limits, plus equipment module and living-quarter module construction. ESDEP lists major deck functions including well control, separation, pumps/compressors, power generation and accommodation. No page read during this sweep explicitly names the cellar/main/mezzanine three-level arrangement Primary source: https://fgg-web.fgg.uni-lj.si/~/pmoze/esdep/master/wg15a/l0100.htm
aliases: Topside decks (cellar deck, main deck, mezzanine as required)

specifications.metric: Integrated / modular topside deck and mo — Single integrated deck weight limit
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 section 5.2.1: "the single integrated deck (up to approx 100 MN)".

specifications.metric: Integrated / modular topside deck and mo — Topside single-lift installation limit
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 section 7.2.4: "For topsides up to approximately 120 MN, the topside may be installed in one lift".

specifications.metric: Integrated / modular topside deck and mo — Major modularized topside weight
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 section 5.2.3: "A major modularized topside weighs 200 to 400 MN".

specifications.metric: Integrated / modular topside deck and mo — Equipment module weight
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 section 6: equipment modules (20-75 MN), rectangular boxes with one or two intermediate floors.

specifications.metric: Integrated / modular topside deck and mo — Living quarter module weight
specifications.basis: ESDEP 15A.1 section 6: living quarter modules (5-25 MN).

specifications.metric: Wellhead area / deck level arrangement — Kebabangan deck content and mass
specifications.basis: Offshore Technology Kebabangan: deck weighs 17,000 t and features a tender-assisted drilling (TAD) rig, utilities and accommodation for staff.

specifications.metric: Reliability — Design life of Tarpon KMSE/AJK WHPs
specifications.basis: Tarpon Systems project page: platforms designed for a 20-year operational lifespan and made relocatable.

As printed: "A $380m (RM1.15bn) contract to fabricate the topsides of the platform was awarded to Sime Darby Engineering in April 2011". Dollar year not stated; article dated 5 May 2016. Not a unit-rate or full project cost.; dollar year not stated.

gaps.why: None of the pages read explicitly names a three-level cellar-main-mezzanine arrangement for a wellhead platform; only CN103758095A mentions a sub-cellar deck.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a WHP topside GA description page and confirm the deck naming and functions.

gaps.what: Deck steel weight for an unmanned WHP
gaps.why: Weight bands read are for integrated/modular production topsides (MN scale), not minimum-facility WHP decks.
gaps.next_action: Fetch a minimum-facility topside weight statement.

gaps.what: USD deck cost with stated dollar year
gaps.why: The $380m figure has no dollar year printed; no other USD topside figure was read.
gaps.next_action: Find a dated-cost source or record literal basis "dollar year not stated" as done here.

notes: From the Mistral-chat WHP component list (6. Structural and Marine Systems). Six structural/marine WHP items were researched from pages actually read with WebFetch. Evidence-first findings: a fixed steel jacket is a pile-founded braced tubular substructure carrying the topside
